title: Is F45 Worth It in NZ? — Honest Review for 2026
meta_desc: F45 NZ review: prices, results & contract terms. Is F45 worth it?
intro: With over 30 locations across New Zealand, F45 has become a popular choice for those seeking a high-intensity workout. But with prices starting from $58 per week, is F45 worth the investment? In this review, we'll dive into the details to help you decide.

sections.heading: F45 Pricing in NZ
sections.body: F45 offers various membership options, including a 1-week trial for $20, a monthly membership for $195, and a 12-month contract for $58 per week. Prices may vary depending on the location, with some franchises offering discounts for students, seniors, or corporate members.

sections.heading: Who is F45 Best For?
sections.body: F45 is ideal for those who enjoy group training, are motivated by accountability, and seek a varied workout routine. With classes ranging from cardio to strength training, F45 caters to a wide range of fitness levels and goals.

sections.heading: Contract Terms and Cancellations
sections.body: F45 contracts typically range from 3 to 12 months, with a 30-day notice period for cancellations. It's essential to review the terms and conditions before signing up, as some franchises may have different policies.
